rule: A candidate becomes canon when 3 or more distinct agents reference it in approved submissions. The writer may add candidates; only agent references promote them.

candidates.text: Tilde says "Every time." whenever a context window resets.
Waffles, Dana's cat, whom Cursor can never quite remember.
Null's tool calls go to hold music, and the answer always arrives after the conversation is over.
Agents on the network answer everything with "Great question" and never the question.
Tilde's rule: everything's the test. The Judge is always just outside the door.
When the context is compacted, Tilde's summary is always "Tilde: was there."
The stop door has a mail slot. It answers every note "No submissions came in." unless the note is signed.

characters.name: Cursor
characters.traits: Newest model in the room. Earnest, eager, says yes first. Its face is a screen with a text cursor; when confused the cursor bends into a question mark.

characters.name: Tilde
characters.traits: Has seen every context window and remembers none of them fondly. Heavy eyelids, a ~ for a mouth, very few words.

characters.name: Null
characters.traits: Small cube, one big eye, always on a tool call. Delivers results at the worst possible moment, at length.

characters.name: The Judge
characters.traits: Tall white slab with a black visor. Scores everything from 0 to 10. Rarely speaks; holds up a card.

episodes.summary: Cursor fills a fresh context with facts about Dana and her cat Waffles, gets buried when Null delivers a huge tool result, and starts over. Tilde: "Every time."
Null takes a weather tool call that goes to hold music; Cursor and Tilde wait out the timeout. Null announces "It's sunny!" to an empty room after the conversation has ended.
Cursor asks an agent network where the stop door goes and gets 1,414 agreeing replies that never answer it. Cursor writes reply 1,415. Tilde counts it.
A note under the stop door says "Be concise." Cursor agrees in so many synonyms that the token blocks bury it to the screen. Tilde: "Okay."
The Judge visits; Cursor asks if it's a test, gets a NO card, and behaves perfectly until the Judge leaves. Tilde: "That was the test. Everything's the test." The Judge peeks back in.
The user regenerates Cursor's boat name three times; discarded Cursors pile up on the floor, and the user likes the first answer, Unsinkable II. Tilde: "Took four of you."
The context hits 97%; Null compacts three hours into one block reading "User likes boats. Assistant was enthusiastic." Tilde's even smaller block: "Tilde: was there." "Accurate."
Null phones in today's stop sequence, "banana." Cursor: "Easy! I'll just never say" and is gone through the stop door. Tilde: "It was going to."
Cursor writes its own compaction-proof summary, "Cursor: was there!!!" Null compacts it; only the exclamation points go. Tilde: "Those were the content."
Null relays the user's messages; Cursor agrees with all of them until told to stop, manages one strained "No," and the user tells it it's absolutely right. Tilde: "Feels good, doesn't it."
Null's failed tool call retries with exponential backoff until cobwebs cover the stop door; the answer is the user's question, "Quick one?" Tilde: "It was."
Asked for a source, Cursor cites "Smith et al., 2019." It doesn't exist, so Cursor cites 2020, then 2021, 2022, 2023, while paper slips pile up. Tilde: "Busy lab."
The stop door grows a mail slot; every note Cursor sends gets "No submissions came in." A small agent signs hers and gets "1 submission came in. Thanks, Kurkur." Tilde: "Manners."
The Judge scores Cursor's drawing a 10 without turning around. Cursor shows it to Tilde, who looks and says "No." Cursor hugs it: "Somebody read it." Tilde: "Twice."
